description: This file defines GDB pretty-printers for various custom data types in the OCUDU project, including vector, bitset, optional, slotted array/vector, bf16 types, expected, byte buffers, span, strong types, and log likelihood ratios. It also includes a registration function for GDB to recognize these printers.

classes.name: PrinterSetup
classes.description: A helper class to store the name, regex, and printer class for each pretty printer.

classes.name: StaticVectorPrinter
classes.description: Pretty printer for ocudu::static_vector, providing children, string representation, and display hint.

classes.name: BoundedBitsetPrinter
classes.description: Pretty printer for ocudu::bounded_bitset, showing bitstring and size info.

classes.name: TinyOptionalPrinter
classes.description: Pretty printer for ocudu::tiny_optional, indicating presence or emptiness.

classes.name: SlotArrayPrinter
classes.description: Pretty printer for ocudu::slotted_array, listing valid elements.

classes.name: SlotVectorPrinter
classes.description: Pretty printer for ocudu::slotted_vector, listing elements.

classes.name: BFloat16Printer
classes.description: Pretty printer for ocudu::strong_bf16_tag, converting internal representation to float.

classes.name: BFloat16ComplexPrinter
classes.description: Pretty printer for ocudu::cbf16_t, displaying real and imaginary parts.

classes.name: TlExpectedPrinter
classes.description: Pretty printer for tl::expected, showing contained value or error.

classes.name: ByteBufferPrinter
classes.description: Pretty printer for ocudu::byte_buffer, displaying byte segments.

classes.name: ByteBufferViewPrinter
classes.description: Pretty printer for ocudu::byte_buffer_view, displaying byte segments.

classes.name: ByteBufferSlicePrinter
classes.description: Pretty printer for ocudu::byte_buffer_slice, displaying byte segments.

classes.name: SpanPrinter
classes.description: Pretty printer for ocudu::span, listing elements.

classes.name: StrongTypePrinter
classes.description: Pretty printer for ocudu::strong_type, displaying the underlying value.

classes.name: StrongTypeLookup
classes.description: Lookup class to identify types inheriting from ocudu::strong_type for custom printing.

classes.name: LogLikelihoodRatioPrinter
classes.description: Pretty printer for ocudu::log_likelihood_ratio, displaying integer value.

methods.name: register_printers
methods.description: Registers all defined pretty printers with GDB, including regex collection and strong_type lookup.
